info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Liquidity Risk Model Update API
info.description: The Liquidity Risk Model Update API is designed to facilitate the management of liquidity risk models within the banking sector. By utilizing this endpoint, financial institutions can update existing liquidity risk models to ensure accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards. This operation is vital for risk analysts and compliance officers who frequently adjust models based on market conditions or internal assessments. The endpoint provides a streamlined method for keeping liquidity risk evaluations current and relevant.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the properties of a specific liquidity risk model identified by its unique ID. Ensure to provide the necessary data in the request body to apply the desired updates effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the liquidity risk model with the specified identifier. It must contain the necessary fields to modify the existing resource, ensuring that all required information is included for successful processing.
